outcome: Consumption of iron supplementation for >=90 days during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 6370 women from Pakistan who had their last childbirth within 5 years before the 2017-2018 Pakistan Demographic Health Survey and responded to questions about iron intake.
finding: Approximately 30% of women consumed iron tablets for at least 90 days during their last pregnancy, with significant predictors including women's age (>=25 years), higher wealth index, higher education level, women's say in choosing a husband, having >= five antenatal care visits, and a history of Caesarian-section.
mod_finding: A history of the last Caesarian-section was significantly associated with iron consumption for >=90 days during pregnancy.
